negative_results.title: Scenario 7 realistic federated local-feature detection failure
negative_results.finding: Federated realistic local-feature condition detected only 5 of 133 pooled Scenario 7 test incidents (3.76% pooled recall; 3.92% mean per-seed recall). Centralized local features detected 0/133 (0.0%).
negative_results.significance: Establishes an empirical negative result: realistic bank-local features fail to detect unseen cross-bank structuring/layering typologies.

negative_results.title: Bank C zero-positive cold-start low-FPR detection failure
negative_results.finding: Bank C federated test recall at the validation-selected 0.1%-FPR operating regime was exactly 0% across all five evaluated seeds (TP = 0, FN = 50, 44, 44, 36, 43).
negative_results.significance: Demonstrates that federated parameter sharing does not yield operational detection at stringent enterprise operating thresholds for zero-positive institutions.

negative_results.title: Federated AP improvement is non-uniform and seed-inconsistent
negative_results.finding: While ROC-AUC gained consistently (+0.1897), the paired AP difference was small (+0.0123 +/- 0.0138) and negative in seed 456 (-0.0048).
negative_results.significance: Federated learning does not guarantee precision-recall improvements across all data splits.

negative_results.title: Federated low-FPR recall shows mixed directional deltas
negative_results.finding: Paired difference in recall at validation-selected 0.1% FPR was +0.0032 +/- 0.0128, exhibiting 2 positive, 2 negative, and 1 zero delta across the five seeds.
negative_results.significance: Federated collaboration does not reliably shift the extreme-tail low-FPR operating point outward.

negative_results.title: Per-bank performance degradation for data-rich institutions (Banks A and B)
negative_results.finding: Federated ROC was lower than isolated local training for Bank A in 5/5 seeds (-0.0293 +/- 0.0104) and for Bank B in 4/5 seeds (-0.0171 +/- 0.0226).
negative_results.significance: Refutes the assumption that federated learning uniformly benefits every participant; pooled gain is driven entirely by rescuing Bank C (+0.3514 dROC).

negative_results.title: Centralized training superior in ROC-AUC across all seeds
negative_results.finding: Centralized pooled training achieved higher ROC-AUC than federated training in 5/5 seeds (federated-minus-centralized paired dROC: -0.0079 +/- 0.0056; central 0.9091 vs fed 0.9013).
negative_results.significance: Disproves universal federated superiority; FedAvg incurs an empirical ranking penalty relative to centralized pooling.

negative_results.title: Isolated cold-start baseline is completely non-discriminative
negative_results.finding: ColdStartLocalBaseline produces constant Laplace prior 1/(n+2), resulting in ROC-AUC 0.5000, realized test FPR 1.0, and an all-positive operating point in every seed.
negative_results.significance: Confirms that local isolated training with zero positive observations yields zero ranking discrimination.

negative_results.title: Linear logistic baseline fails low-FPR operational detection
negative_results.finding: Balanced Logistic Regression achieved 0 recall, 0 precision, and 0 F1 at the validation-selected 0.1% FPR threshold in all five seeds.
negative_results.significance: Demonstrates that linear decision boundaries fail completely in the ultra-low-FPR detection regime.

negative_results.title: Federated realistic condition total low-FPR detection failure in seed 456
negative_results.finding: In seed 456, federated realistic training achieved exactly 0.0000 recall (TP = 0 on pooled test views) at the validation-selected threshold.
negative_results.significance: Shows that stochastic partitioning and optimization can lead to complete operational detection failure even with federated collaboration.

negative_results.title: Oracle condition is bounded by optimization rather than information
negative_results.finding: Despite receiving a label-equivalent feature, oracle AP dropped as low as 0.7313 (seed 42) and ROC as low as 0.8232 (seed 42).
negative_results.significance: Reveals that neural network optimization, batching, feature scaling, and FedAvg parameter averaging fail to achieve 1.0 performance even with perfect ground-truth inputs.
